summary_en: Medipal Holdings completed tender offer for PALTAC: 24,466,104 shares acquired at ¥6,650/share (39.5% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), total ¥162.7B. Offer period 12 May – 7 July 2026 (41 business days). Minimum acceptance threshold 8,676,100 shares met.
title_en: Notice regarding results of the tender offer for common shares of PALTAC Inc. (Securities Code: 8283)
translation_en_brief: Medipal Holdings Corporation announced the completion of its tender offer for common shares of PALTAC Inc. (TSE Prime, Code 8283) on 8 July 2026. The tender offer ran from 12 May to 7 July 2026 (41 business days) at ¥6,650 per share. The offer was structured with a minimum acceptance threshold of 8,676,100 shares and no upper limit; 24,466,104 shares were tendered and acquired, representing 39.5% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). Total acquisition value was approximately ¥162.7 billion. The minimum threshold was satisfied, so all tendered shares were purchased as announced in the offer documentation. The result was publicly disclosed on 8 July 2026 via Tokyo Stock Exchange announcement to the media.
